status.description: completed = every requested edit applied; partial = some edits failed after retries; failed = nothing landed.

fileEntryId.description: File entry id of the edited deck.

fileName.description: Deck file name as reported by the tools.

pages.description: Total page count of the deck.

outline.description: Final per-page titles of the deck.

warnings.description: Edit-level tolerance warnings and failed operations worth reporting to the user.

summary.description: Concise outcome for the caller to relay: what was edited, failed operations and reasons, or why nothing landed.
